responses.reply: Transformer models use self-attention mechanisms to process entire sequences in parallel, unlike RNNs. This makes them significantly faster to train and better at capturing long-range dependencies in text.
NLP (Natural Language Processing) is a field of AI focused on enabling machines to understand and generate human language. Modern NLP is dominated by large pretrained models like BERT and GPT.

BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers) is a pretrained model by Google that reads text bidirectionally. It revolutionized NLP tasks like classification, NER, and question answering.
GPT (Generative Pretrained Transformer) is an autoregressive language model by OpenAI. It generates text by predicting the next token, and has scaled to billions of parameters.
The paper's methodology involves a systematic literature review of deep learning approaches in NLP from 2015–2023, categorizing models by architecture type and benchmark performance.
Key findings show that transformer-based models consistently outperform RNN and CNN-based architectures across all major NLP benchmarks, with BERT achieving state-of-the-art on GLUE.
The paper concludes that while transformers dominate NLP, open challenges remain: low-resource languages, computational cost, and model interpretability need further research.
In short: this survey traces NLP from statistical methods to transformers, shows transformers win across the board, but flags efficiency and multilingual support as unsolved problems.
This paper was written by Zhang, L., Wang, S., and Liu, B., published in the Journal of Machine Learning Research in 2023.
This paper has 124 citations, indicating strong impact in the NLP research community since its publication in May 2023.
